subScenes.name: 热情迎接
subScenes.description: 主人热情欢迎朋友到来，表达开心相见。

qaPairs.triggerText: Hey! You made it! We’ve been waiting for you!
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 嘿！你来了！我们等你好久了！
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 朋友聚会，主人热情迎接来访者

followUps.text: I couldn’t miss this! Thanks for having me!
followUps.text_cn: 我怎么可能错过！谢谢你邀请我！

followUps.text: Sorry I’m late! Traffic was insane.
followUps.text_cn: 抱歉我迟到了，交通太糟了。

followUps.text: I brought a bottle of wine—hope it’s not too much!
followUps.text_cn: 我带了瓶红酒，希望没多带！

qaPairs.usageNote: 适用于朋友聚会时主人热情迎接，来访者根据自身情况自然回应，体现真实社交互动

qaPairs.triggerText: Come in, come in! Take off your coat!
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 快进来，快进来！把外套脱了！
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 朋友聚会，主人热情迎接并引导入座

followUps.text: Thanks! This place looks amazing!
followUps.text_cn: 谢谢！这地方看起来太棒了！

followUps.text: I’ll just leave it here—where’s the bathroom?
followUps.text_cn: 我先放这儿吧，洗手间在哪？

followUps.text: I’m good, I’ll keep it on—I’m a bit chilly!
followUps.text_cn: 我先不脱了，我有点冷！

qaPairs.usageNote: 主人引导入内时，访客可选择赞美、行动或表达个人需求，体现自然社交灵活性

qaPairs.triggerText: You’re finally here! I was starting to think you ghosted us!
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 你终于来了！我差点以为你放我们鸽子了！
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 朋友聚会，主人用轻松调侃语气迎接迟到的访客

followUps.text: Haha, never! I just got stuck in a meeting!
followUps.text_cn: 哈哈，怎么可能！我刚被会议拖住了！

followUps.text: I’m so sorry—I didn’t realize how late it got!
followUps.text_cn: 真的对不起，我没意识到时间这么晚了！

followUps.text: Nah, I’m here now—let’s get the drinks started!
followUps.text_cn: 算了，我现在不是来了嘛，咱们赶紧开喝吧！

qaPairs.usageNote: 当主人用玩笑式抱怨迎接时，访客可选择幽默化解、真诚道歉或顺势带动气氛，体现社交情商

subScenes.name: 提供饮料
subScenes.description: 主人询问客人想喝什么并提供饮品选择。

qaPairs.triggerText: What would you like to drink?
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 朋友聚会中，有人主动提供饮料选择

followUps.text: I'll have a soda, please.
followUps.text_cn: 我要一杯苏打水，谢谢。

followUps.text: Do you have anything non-alcoholic? I'm not drinking tonight.
followUps.text_cn: 有非酒精饮料吗？我今晚不喝酒。

followUps.text: I'm good for now, thanks—I'm still on my first drink.
followUps.text_cn: 我暂时不用，谢谢，我还在喝第一杯呢。

qaPairs.usageNote: 用于朋友聚会时回应他人提供的饮料选择，体现礼貌与个人偏好

qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 朋友在聚会中提供热饮选项

followUps.text: Coffee, black, please.
followUps.text_cn: 咖啡，不加奶，谢谢。

followUps.text: Neither, thanks—I'm good with water.
followUps.text_cn: 都不用，谢谢，我喝水就行。

followUps.text: Tea, but could I get it with lemon?
followUps.text_cn: 我要茶，但能加点柠檬吗？

qaPairs.usageNote: 回应热饮选择时，体现具体偏好或简单需求，符合自然社交语境

qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 朋友在聚会中提供酒精与非酒精选项

followUps.text: I'll take a beer, thanks!
followUps.text_cn: 我要一杯啤酒，谢谢！

followUps.text: I'm driving, so just sparkling water for me.
followUps.text_cn: 我开车呢，就给我一杯气泡水吧。

followUps.text: Hmm, I'm torn—what do you recommend?
followUps.text_cn: 嗯，我拿不定主意——你推荐哪个？

qaPairs.usageNote: 在有酒精选项的聚会中，回应饮料选择，体现责任意识或社交互动

subScenes.name: 寒暄近况
subScenes.description: 双方简单问候，聊聊最近生活和工作。

qaPairs.triggerText: What have you been up to lately?

followUps.text: I’ve been swamped with work, but finally took a weekend trip last week!
followUps.text_cn: 最近工作超忙，但上周终于去度了个周末假！

followUps.text: Honestly? Just surviving. Kids are sick, and I haven’t slept properly in weeks.
followUps.text_cn: 说实话？就是硬撑着。孩子生病了，好几个星期没睡好觉。

followUps.text: Not much, just the usual—work, Netflix, repeat.
followUps.text_cn: 没什么特别的，就是老样子：上班、看剧、循环。

qaPairs.usageNote: 用于朋友间自然寒暄，回应时可根据真实状态选择积极、消极或中性语气，避免过度官方或敷衍。

followUps.text: Amazing! I got promoted last month and started learning guitar on the side.
followUps.text_cn: 太棒了！上个月升职了，还顺便开始学吉他。

followUps.text: It’s been okay, but I’m trying to cut back on coffee—I’m addicted!
followUps.text_cn: 还行吧，不过我正努力少喝咖啡——我上瘾了！

followUps.text: Same as always, really. You know how it is.
followUps.text_cn: 还是老样子，你知道的。

qaPairs.usageNote: 回应时可结合个人真实状态，用轻松语气表达生活状态，避免只说 'Fine' 或 'Good' 这类单字回答。

qaPairs.triggerText: How’s life treating you these days?

followUps.text: Better than expected—I finally moved out of my parents’ place!
followUps.text_cn: 比预期好多了！我终于搬出父母家了！

followUps.text: To be honest, I’m feeling a bit stuck. Not sure what I want to do next.
followUps.text_cn: 说实话，我有点卡住了，不知道下一步该做什么。

followUps.text: Pretty good! Just got back from a road trip with my dog.
followUps.text_cn: 挺好的！刚和我的狗去自驾游回来。

qaPairs.usageNote: 这句话更口语化、更温暖，适合熟人之间。回应时可适度暴露情绪，增强真实感和连接感。

subScenes.name: 介绍环境
subScenes.description: 主人引导客人认识房间和在场其他朋友。

qaPairs.triggerText: Welcome! This is my place — I just moved in last month.
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 欢迎！这是我的家——我上个月刚搬进来。
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 朋友介绍自己的新居环境

followUps.text: Wow, this living room is so cozy! I love the lighting.
followUps.text_cn: 哇，这个客厅太温馨了！我喜欢这里的灯光。

followUps.text: Really? I didn’t know you were moving — how’s the neighborhood?
followUps.text_cn: 真的吗？我都不知道你搬家了——这附近怎么样？

followUps.text: Nice! I’m just gonna grab a drink — this place feels so chill.
followUps.text_cn: 不错！我去拿杯饮料——这地方感觉真放松。

qaPairs.usageNote: 用于朋友聚会中，当主人介绍居住环境时，学习者可自然回应，展现社交参与感。

qaPairs.triggerText: I turned the balcony into a little garden — check it out!
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 我把阳台改成了个小花园——来看看！
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 朋友展示个性化空间改造

followUps.text: That’s amazing! I’ve always wanted a balcony garden — what plants do you have?
followUps.text_cn: 太棒了！我一直想有个阳台花园——你种了什么植物？

followUps.text: Cool, but I’d kill any plant in a week — I’m not that green-thumbed.
followUps.text_cn: 挺酷的，但我养啥死啥——我根本没绿手指。

followUps.text: Looks great! Mind if I take a pic for Instagram?
followUps.text_cn: 看起来很棒！介意我拍张照发Instagram吗？

qaPairs.usageNote: 当朋友展示个人改造空间时，回应可体现兴趣、幽默或社交互动，避免仅说‘好棒’等单一反应。

qaPairs.triggerText: The kitchen’s a bit small, but I love cooking here — it’s my happy place.
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 厨房有点小，但我超爱在这儿做饭——这是我的快乐角落。
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 朋友分享对特定空间的情感连接

followUps.text: That’s so sweet — I cook here too when I visit. Want to make dinner together sometime?
followUps.text_cn: 真暖心——我来这儿时也常做饭。哪天一起做顿饭吧？

followUps.text: I get that — my kitchen’s a mess, but I still make coffee there every morning.
followUps.text_cn: 我懂，我厨房乱糟糟的，但每天早上还是会在那儿煮咖啡。

followUps.text: Oh, okay — I’ll just grab a soda from the fridge then.
followUps.text_cn: 哦，好的——那我先去冰箱拿罐苏打水。

qaPairs.usageNote: 当朋友表达对空间的情感依恋时，回应可选择共情、分享或轻描淡写回避，体现真实社交多样性。

subScenes.name: 轻松告别
subScenes.description: 聚会尾声，主人礼貌道别并期待下次再见。

qaPairs.triggerText: Alright, I’m heading out — you good to go?
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 朋友聚会结束，对方主动提出告别，询问你是否一起走

followUps.text: Yeah, I’m ready too — thanks for tonight!
followUps.text_cn: 我也准备好了，谢谢今晚的聚会！

followUps.text: Can I stay a bit longer? I wanna chat with Sam before leaving.
followUps.text_cn: 我能再待一会儿吗？我想在走前和Sam再聊几句。

followUps.text: Definitely! Let’s do this again next week?
followUps.text_cn: 当然！我们下周再聚一次？

qaPairs.usageNote: 用于朋友聚会结束时，回应对方的告别提议，体现自然社交反应

qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 朋友因时间原因提前告别，语气轻松但明确

followUps.text: Same here — let’s grab coffee soon!
followUps.text_cn: 我也是！咱们改天喝咖啡吧！

followUps.text: Wait, can I walk you to the bus stop?
followUps.text_cn: 等一下，我陪你走到公交站好吗？

followUps.text: Yeah, go ahead — I’ll stay and help clean up.
followUps.text_cn: 你先走吧，我留下帮忙收拾。

qaPairs.usageNote: 回应对方因时间紧张而告别的场景，体现体贴与社交细腻度

qaPairs.triggerText: Time to call it a night, right?
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 朋友用试探性语气确认是否该结束聚会

followUps.text: Totally — that was the best night!
followUps.text_cn: 完全同意！这是最棒的一晚！

followUps.text: Hmm… I’m not tired yet — wanna grab a late snack?
followUps.text_cn: 嗯…我还不困，要不要去吃个夜宵？

followUps.text: Yeah, but can we text about that plan tomorrow?
followUps.text_cn: 对，但我们明天再聊那个计划吧？

qaPairs.usageNote: 用于朋友试探性提议结束聚会时，回应需体现情绪与社交意图的微妙差异
